messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['As a value customer, you are required to confirm your continued membership.', 'At your request we have closed your account.', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'If you signed up for Bill Pay, your Bill Pay service, including any pending payments or payee information, will also be canceled at that time.', 'If this sign up was made by the mistake, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the sign-up options in this message, and then change the password on your Apple account, perhaps it was stolen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Confirm membership to retain service, or manage subscriptions by canceling accounts, orders, and Bill Pay; secure your account if signup was unauthorized."}
